review_evidence: README explicitly describes add-combi as a Lean theorem-prover library intended to cover additive combinatorics and built on Mathlib.
The hydrated snapshot has 14 Lean files with more than one hundred theorem/lemma declarations, rather than application or editor tooling.
AddCombi/BSG.lean alone develops a sequence of density/cardinality lemmas and claims toward Balog–Szemerédi–Gowers style arguments, providing directly reusable mathematical prior art.
summary: Retain add-combi as a substantive Lean library of additive-combinatorics definitions and proofs.

review_evidence: Ran `grep -cE '\b(theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom)\b'` over all 3 files; every file had a nonzero match count (range 8-92).

Read the opening of AddCombi/Convolution/Finite/Defs.lean (19383 bytes, the largest file in the unit, 92 matches): module-doc for compact-normalisation discrete convolution (`conv`, `dconv`, `iterConv` with notations `∗`, `○`, `∗^`) followed by real imports and section declarations.

Read AddCombi/Mathlib/Combinatorics/Additive/Sidon.lean in full (4346 bytes, the smallest file in the unit, 8 matches): module-doc-documented `def IsMulSidon` (with `to_additive`-generated `IsAddSidon`), and proved theorems `IsMulSidon.mono`, `.empty`, `.of_subsingleton`, `.singleton`, `.iUnion`, `.sUnion`, `.pair`.
summary: Ran the declaration-keyword grep across all 3 changed/added files: every file had a nonzero match count (range 8-92), so no zero-content candidate exists. Read the opening of the largest file and the whole of the smallest file as representative samples. Both are genuine additive-combinatorics content: Convolution/Finite/Defs.lean opens with a module doc introducing discrete convolution (`conv`, `dconv`, `iterConv`) followed by real definitions, and Mathlib/Combinatorics/Additive/Sidon.lean is a complete, fully proved development of multiplicative/additive Sidon sets (`IsMulSidon`/`IsAddSidon` via `to_additive`) with several proved lemmas. Consistent with the prior review's characterization of this source as a substantive additive-combinatorics library. All 3 files stay searchable; no exclusions.
